query: 'SELECT
    CAST(diagnosis_id AS INT) AS diagnosis_id,
    CAST(admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id,
    UPPER(
        REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(icd_code AS VARCHAR(100)))),
                    '-', '.'
                ),
                ' ,', ','
            ),
            ', ', ', '
        )
    ) AS icd_code,
    CASE
        WHEN diagnosis_description IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(diagnosis_description AS NVARCHAR(255)))) = N''
            THEN N'No Especificado'
        ELSE UPPER(LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(diagnosis_description AS NVARCHAR(255)))), 1))
             + SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(diagnosis_description AS NVARCHAR(255)))), 2, LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(diagnosis_description AS NVARCHAR(255))))))
    END AS diagnosis_description,
    CASE
        WHEN severity IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(severity AS VARCHAR(50)))) = ''
            THEN 'No Especificado'
        ELSE UPPER(LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(severity AS VARCHAR(50)))), 1))
             + LOWER(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(severity AS VARCHAR(50)))), 2, LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(severity AS VARCHAR(50)))))))
    END AS severity
FROM bronze.diagnoses
WHERE diagnosis_id IS NOT NULL
  AND admission_id IS NOT NULL
  AND icd_code IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(icd_code AS VARCHAR(100)))) <> ''',
